ITEM 1 | Large white square plate, about 26 cm across, serving as the reference; food occupies the lower-right quadrant | 0
ITEM 2 | Pale golden-brown roasted potato-like chunks, roughly 2-3 cm each, with browned, slightly glossy surfaces and soft interiors, sitting near the center-right of the food pile | 90
ITEM 3 | Brown, seared meat slices, about 6-8 cm long and 1 cm thick, with darker caramelized edges, dry-looking surface and firm texture, fanned out in a diagonal stack on the right side | 85
ITEM 4 | Bright green leafy vegetable pieces, wilted and glossy with some oil, scattered among the potatoes and meat, roughly 2-4 cm long, flat and limp | 25
ITEM 5 | Rolled or folded pale-yellow wrapper pieces with browned spots and green filling showing at one end, about 3-4 cm long, moderately soft, sitting at the top right and bottom left edges | 40
ITEM 6 | Crumbly, golden-brown pieces with a rough, bumpy textured surface, about 2-3 cm, possibly coated, near the center-left of the pile | 30
ITEM 7 | Small translucent-pale pieces and bits of light brown sauce or glaze, thinly smeared over the food and plate, glossy and slightly sticky-looking | 10
